text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon, while I'm relaxing in my office…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Trainer. We'd really like to get your advice on something…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh do say yes! Pretty please! Come on, "yes" on three! One, two—
choice_data_list: Sure. What do you want advice on?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You see, we're going to be interviewed tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: They plan to have a photo shoot, but…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru told me that if I have my picture taken, my soul will be sucked out of my body. Apparently, I need to "avoid it at all costs."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And that's the truth! They get you with that shutter, and click! Your soul's jumping straight out of ya! All that's left is a shell!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Though I do think Suzuka'll end up fine, seeing how fast she is. But I'm afraid they'll catch me straight away!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I think… that's just a superstition.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Watch it! This is just like baking bread—let your guard down for one minute and you're toast!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What are you gonna do if we drop our guards and get our souls vacuumed right out? Just thinking about it is giving me the heebie-jeebies…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Any ideas, Trainer? How do we deal with those huge cameras reporters are always lugging around?!
choice_data_list: Modern cameras don't take your soul, so you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Modern cameras? You mean they're safer than the older ones?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give Matikanefukukitaru a brief explanation on how cameras have evolved.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm, I see what you're saying… So these cameras don't work like those evil daguerreotype ones made with silver and mercury…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You learn something new every day! You're so smart, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Guess there's nothing for me to be scared of.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahem. So Suzuka, allow me to explain. There is nothing to fear. You see, the thing about modern cameras—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Erm… I've been right next to you listening this whole time…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru sounds like an expert now. It looks like she came out of this exchange a little wiser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What a suggestion! You want us to plot a soul-salvaging tactic to take back what's rightfully ours?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! It's a little risky, but it might just work! I'll snatch back my soul before that camera even knows it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If I don't do anything, everyone will end up soul-sucked, all across the country—sad shells of themselves.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: You're up next, Fukukitaru. Look at the camera and say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nooo, I got snapped!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Time to strike back before they steal my soul!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hum-dilly-dee, come back to me! Soul retrieval magic!

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wh-what was that? Is that some sort of performance?! It was pretty neat, so shall we get another shot of it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's desperately rattling off incantations at the camera. We should probably channel all that energy she has somewhere else.
